title: Header navigation links that are visible on a desktop-width page must not be hidden from screen readers
summary: On wide screens the header script marks the always-visible navigation aria-hidden, so screen reader users cannot find the links that keyboard focus still lands on.
consumer: Author-written fishing licence service page around the unchanged upstream header source at buggyCommit (released in v3.9.0); an import map resolves the upstream extensionless relative imports to the pinned .js files.
